newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-TOTTENHAM SET TO BUY FERDINAND FOR 6 MLN POUNDS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TOTTENHAM SET TO BUY FERDINAND FOR 6 MLN POUNDS.

text.p: Newcastle have accepted a six million pound ($10 million) offer from Tottenham for England international striker Les Ferdinand.
"A six million pound fee has been agreed with Spurs," Newcastle's Clubcall service reported on Friday.

If the deal between the two premier league clubs is concluded, it will put Tottenham in the curious position of having sold one England striker -- Teddy Sheringham to Manchester United -- for 3.5 million pounds to replace him with another of a similar age for far more.
Newspapers quoted Tottenham chairman Alan Sugar as saying that personal terms had yet to be agreed.
"We are hoping to talk to him over the weekend and hopefully he will be our player by the start of the season," Sugar said of the 30-year-old player.

North London club Tottenham are coached by Ferdinand's former Queens Park Rangers boss Gerry Francis. Although Everton have also shown an interest in the striker, Ferdinand wants to return to the capital.
Last week French winger David Ginola left Newcastle to join Tottenham, who are keen to boost their squad with major signings before next month's start to the new season.
